args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the latest deploy, checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. The v2.3.1-rc build was also unhealthy in staging. I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions. After the rollback the service is healthy and the error rate is 0.2%. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and the service is healthy again.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was live in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been marked unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. It's now running in all three regions, health checks are passing and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, which paged on-call. It describes the failure and the rollback, and recommends finding the root cause before v2.3.1 is deployed again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
